Actions should target exactly the ticked bookmarks, and it’s fine for that to include selected items that are merely scrolled off-screen. However, changing the search or switching views should clear the selection so I can’t accidentally act on bookmarks that have become hidden. “Select all shown” must remain limited to the search and view active when I select it.

For Remove tag, I’d prefer to choose from the tags actually present on the selected bookmarks. If only some selected bookmarks have that tag, applying the action should remove it from those bookmarks and leave the others unchanged.
